name: Farakai
description: The Farakai were a large anthropoid sentient species from the Outer Rim. They possessing a unique bonding ability in which two individuals would be joined with a bridge of bone and muscle. The Farakai were brutal and powerful and a notoriously secretive species that had clandestine rituals of war and mating. The Farakai Chu bonded with the Rodian Lok to become Chulok, who would become a gangster operating on the planet Metagos.
